content.title: Aday Mara - Men's Basketball - University of Michigan Athletics
content.text: Pronunciations First Name: "uh-dye" Last Name: "MAR-uh" Who is Aday Mara? • Skilled big man with a large impact on both ends of the floor • Height and length give him a significant advantage in the paint • Finishes around the basket, especially on dump-off passes and putbacks • Strong rebounder, both offensively and defensively • Play is instrumental in helping with the team's offensive and defensive flow • Shot blocker, presence alters shots and impacts the opponent's offensive flow • Great court vision and passing instincts • Working on strength, defending on the perimeter • International experience with Spain's National Team Career: Michigan • Helped Michigan to an outright Big Ten regular-season title (2025-26) • U-M’s first regular-season title since 2020-21 • Led Michigan to a program and Big Ten-best 19-1 conference record • Helped U-M to NCAA Tournament (2026) • Awarded No. 3 overall seed, No. 1-seed in Midwest Regional • No. 1 seed for the fourth time in program history (1985, 1993, 2021, 2026) Honors & Awards • 2026 Big Ten Defensive Player of the Year • All-Big Ten, third team (2026, coaches and media) • All-Big Ten Defensive Team (2026) Season: 2025-26 (Michigan) • Portal transfer from UCLA • Played in 39 games, with 38 starts • Averaging 12.2 points per game • One of four Wolverines averaging 10-plus points per game • Has 28 games of double-digit scoring, with three of 20-plus • Scored a career-high 26 points in the Final Four vs. Arizona (April 4) • Shooting a team-high 67.0 percent (197-for-294) from the field • Leads U-M in made field goals • Has 19 games of five-plus field goals, with three of 10-plus • Made a career-high 11 field goals on 16 attempts (68.8 percent) twice: • at Ohio State (Feb. 8) • vs. Arizona • Made first career three-pointer at Ohio State • Shot 2-for-3 from beyond the arc • Averaging 6.8 rebounds per game • Posted six games of 10-plus rebounds and 33 games of five-plus • 12: vs. Oakland
